# ArtCraft brand files: removed in the InkWitness fork

Upstream WordCraft keeps the ArtCraft name, wordmark and logos in this folder. Its
`LICENSE-brand.txt` says forks and modified versions must remove them, so the InkWitness
fork deletes the image files and keeps only that license text. InkWitness's own artwork is in
`assets/brand/` at the repository root.

InkWitness is based on WordCraft by the ArtCraft team. It is not affiliated with or endorsed
by the ArtCraft Team.
